Priya R.: heads-up — I'm stuck at the airport, inbound flight delayed ~3h. I need someone to take primary for the 06:00-14:00 UTC window (about 4am local for me). Pager volume has spiked; saw 3 criticals in the last hour. runbook: https://redwood.runbooks/primary-handbook :airplane:
Ethan M.: I can take primary for that block if Priya wants to hand off now. I'm on-call-friendly but have a deploy at 08:30 UTC — can pause if needed. @Kai L. wanna shadow for the first hour?
Kai L.: yep can shadow 06:00-08:00 UTC. Will monitor latency dashboards and traces. No deploys for me. ping me if you handover. :ok_hand:
oncall-bot: [pager] INC-9853 high p99 latency on /v1/generate (eu-west-1). 3 alerts: increase in queue depth, 502 spikes, autoscaler thrash. Link: https://monitoring.redwood/alerts/INC-9853
Ops Runbook: quick checklist snippet for handoff and active mitigation - paste into thread:
```
- Confirm primary identity in channel
- Share active incidents (INC-IDs)
- Copy recent mitigations and pending runbook steps
- Keep shadow channel open and escalate to L2 if scope > 30m
- Escalation matrix: pager -> #eng-sre -> paging@redwood (oncall escalation)
```
Ops Runbook: quick mitigation commands (EU cluster):
```
# check pods
kubectl -n runtime get pods -l app=inference -o wide
# tail runtime logs
kubectl -n runtime logs -l app=inference -c runtime --since=15m | grep -i error
# restart canary pool
redwoodctl pools restart --region eu-west-1 --pool canary
```
Priya R.: INC-9853 is the one. Current mitigations: scaled canary pool x2 at 05:40 UTC, rolled back the latest quantized model at 05:47 UTC (suspected perf regression). No customer postmortem yet. I will DM detailed notes to @Ethan M. now.
Ethan M.: got the DM. Repeating key points for the channel: scaled canary, rollback done, watch queue depth and p99. If 502s persist >10m escalate to SRE and trigger traffic spill to us-west.
Kai L.: noted. I'll keep trace link open and pre-load the common repro prompts. If anyone sees KV-cache stalls, tag me.
Priya R.: handing primary to @Ethan M. — I'm formally passing now. I'll remain reachable by DM but won't be primary. :wave:
Ethan M.: taking primary. setting status to "Primary — Ethan" in the rota. I'll open a short watch doc and update INC-9853 with timestamps. :thumbsup:
oncall-bot: ack received. Pager ownership updated: primary=Ethan M., shadow=Kai L. Incident INC-9853 updated with handoff note.
Ethan M.: final note — if latency doesn't drop after 15m, runbook step 'canary pool scale + reduce batch_size to 8' (see runbook above). Kai, can you validate batch_size change if needed?
